title: Lq Estimator
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset/Parameter Estimation/PMSM Parameter Estimation/Lq_Estimator.md
text: Estimate stator inductance ( L q ) of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), 4 inputs, 3 outputs; {Maximum current limit (A)} sets the maximum allowed current during test, {Step size during injected voltage ramp up (per-unit)}, {Number of sinusoidal voltage injections per frequency sweep step} sets the number of sinusoidal voltage injections per frequency during frequency and {Number of sinusoidal voltage injections per frequency during Lq estimation}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: StartStop
ports.summary: Control signal for L q estimation logical

ports.name: Vabc
ports.summary: a, b, and c -axis stator reference voltage components vector

params.name: Maximum current limit (A)
params.values: Maximum allowed current during test 15 (default) | scalar

params.name: Step size during injected voltage ramp up (per-unit)
params.values: Step size during injected voltage ramp up 0.0001 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of sinusoidal voltage injections per frequency sweep step
params.values: Number of sinusoidal voltage injections per frequency during frequency sweep 5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of sinusoidal voltage injections per frequency during Lq estimation
params.values: Number of sinusoidal voltage injections per frequency during Lq estimation 5 (default) | scalar
